WITH member_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.department,
        COUNT(mem.member_id) as member_count
    FROM major m
    INNER JOIN member mem ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
    GROUP BY m.department
),
totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members
    FROM member_counts
),
with_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.department,
        mc.member_count,
        CAST(mc.member_count AS REAL) / t.total_members as share
    FROM member_counts mc
    CROSS JOIN totals t
),
avg_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value
    FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
    ws.department,
    ws.member_count,
    ws.share,
    ws.share - a.avg_share_value as share_minus_avg
FROM with_shares ws
CROSS JOIN avg_share a
WHERE ws.share >= a.avg_share_value
ORDER BY ws.department
